_acceptance_criteria.description: An account qualifies for this watchlist if it satisfies ALL 5 criteria:
criteria: 1. Posts about projects with NO live token yet (pre-TGE, pre-mainnet)
2. Mentions SPECIFIC project names — not general commentary
3. References backing signals: VC names, funding rounds, testnet, node/ambassador programs
4. Posts BEFORE the project trends — small/mid following preferred (under 50K ideal)
5. Structured or specific calls — numbered lists or individual conviction posts
_acceptance_criteria.note: Zun2025 is the benchmark example, not the standard itself. Any account satisfying all 5 qualifies.

_tier_guide.tier_1: Satisfies all 5 criteria. Deep infrastructure focus. Conviction calls. Full research weight.
_tier_guide.tier_2: Satisfies 4/5 criteria. Broader scope or larger following. Slightly discounted weight.
_tier_guide.tier_0: PROBATION — in reserve. Not fetched in scans. Promoted to tier 2 automatically if cross-mentioned by tier-1/2 accounts within 30 days, or manually via /approve_watchlist.
_tier_guide.weight: 1.0 = full tier power. 0.85 = strong but slightly below top. 0.75 = solid, being evaluated.
